title: The Works: Undo is kept with your yard
lines: Undo undoes the whole of the last thing you did, or none of it. If you're short of Coins, nothing is undone.
What you can undo is kept with your yard: it is still there after you reload the page, and on another device.

more.head: Changed
points: The Undo button shows only while there is something to undo.
When Undo brings back a piece you took away, it comes back empty: what it held was lost when you took it away.
After an update to the Works, there is nothing to undo from before it.
Undo keeps up to 20 changes. Setting what a machine makes or what a sorter sorts, opening or shutting a crate, and buying a plot cannot be undone, and Undo forgets everything before them.
Something very large done at once, such as taking away most of a big yard, cannot be undone. Undo says so.

more.head: Fixed
points: Undoing the removal of your free starting mill gives that mill back free, and a mill you paid for back as paid.
Undo counts the Coins in your till once, not twice.
